name: gcki-continued
title: Gizmos Car Keys (continued)
author: Pi-C
description: Claim, lock and summon your vehicle with car keys. With Space Age enabled, keep one claimed vehicle per planet and summon only the vehicle on your current planet. Keys cannot be used on space platforms. Without Space Age, keep one globally claimed vehicle. Supports most modded car and spider-vehicle prototypes. Based on Gizmos Car Keys by AoDGizmo.
